headline: Strong growth momentum; margin resilience despite headwinds

highlights: EBITDA grew 45% yoy (~14% above our estimates), while EBITDAM improved ~30bps qoq to 11.8%, despite commodity headwinds.

The management remains committed to its Vision 2030 (targeting Rs175bn revenue; implying ~30% FY26-30E CAGR; refer to our report—Vision 2030 – Targets 3.5x revenue; >25% ROCEs), transitioning from component to system solution offerings, with MDA consistently delivering robust growth over recent quarters.
PVs are expected to contribute over 25% of the revenue mix (vs ~18% currently), supported by multiple product developments targeting the segment.
Key growth drivers include TFT cluster (multiple orders secured; lifetime value of >Rs10bn; SOP from FY28), sunroofs (SOP commenced in 2Q), and power footstep (first order secured).
